About Me

Hi, I'm Mai Mohamed.

I started with a pencil and a blank page, and I'm still chasing that same feeling — watching a face take shape stroke by stroke.

Oil, charcoal and ink are how I think out loud. Portraiture, especially, has become my language: every line is an attempt to catch something true about a person.

I'm still a student, still learning, and every piece here is a step in that process.
